data.one_liner: Telegram bot framework for Dart with strong typing and filter systems
data.what_it_does: Televerse lets developers build and deploy Telegram bots in Dart. It features a filter system, update handlers, keyboard utilities, conversation plugins, and strict typing with no dynamic types on the public interface.
use_when: You want to build a Telegram bot using Dart
You need a strictly typed API framework for Telegram Bot API updates
avoid_when: You are building web or mobile apps that do not involve Telegram bots
strengths: Zero dynamic types on the public interface for full type safety
Extensive built-in filter and listener system with over 80 filters
Includes conversation, session, and logging plugins out of the box
weaknesses: Limited exclusively to Telegram bot development
data.setup_notes: Simply add the dependency to pubspec.yaml, import the package, and initialize the Bot with your token.
